g.text: it. Rows without a mark: one run per round, two rounds. "1 run": a single

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #1f2328

g.text: run, on xfs in its own part of the session, and for the plain file (*) in

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #1f2328

g.text: a separate part, later. Lower is better.
